title: デビュー戦の後に・大型新人

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon's great performance at her debut puts her on everyone's radar.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows to push herself to even greater heights in her pursuit of the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A runner named Rice Shower watches Mihono Bourbon very intently as she runs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her ability to bring smiles to the faces of the spectators makes her the object of Rice Shower's admiration.
